$comment: The single pinned Core revision this app is built and tested against. See docs/INTEGRATION.md §3. A bump is a deliberate PR that re-vendors schemas, re-runs TS codegen, re-captures trace fixtures, and moves the valyria-bridge git dep rev.
$runtime_version_note: null until the first `hello` handshake against the pinned build records it; xtask verify-core fills it in.
$gap_closure_note: Bumped from 9203d23 / protocol 1.0.0 for CORE-INTERFACE gap closure G1-G15, now landed on Core main (PRs #15-#25). git_rev is the main merge commit.
$protocol_1_11_note: Protocol 1.11.0 adds license-gated + cancellable model install (ModelInstallRequest.accept_license, model_install_cancel), ModelInspectResponse.license_text / license_accepted_at_ms, and display_name / parameters_b / context_length / active_roles on ModelSummaryWire. Schemas re-vendored + codegen re-run; git_rev is Core's main commit that landed it.
$protocol_1_12_note: Protocol 1.12.0 adds real local inference: a new `model_inference` capability, and seven new event kinds — engine_install_{progress,completed,failed} (Core downloads its own llama-server, no `brew install`) and model_server_{starting,ready,failed,stopped} (a per-role managed server's lifecycle). No new Request/Response variants. `git_rev` points at a commit on Core's `feat/local-inference` branch — pushed, but not yet merged to Core's main; CI resolves it fine as an ordinary git-dependency rev. Move `git_rev` to the merged main SHA once that Core PR lands.
$release_note: The prebuilt Core binary the app's release pipeline downloads and checksums for each platform (docs/RELEASING.md §Core binary, xtask verify-core / verify-core-release). `release.tag` MUST resolve (via `git ls-remote`) to the same commit as `git_rev` above. PLACEHOLDER: no Core release has been cut yet — these are scaffold values (sha256 all-zero) so xtask's offline shape check passes; `verify-core-release` will correctly fail until this is bumped to a real Core release per docs/RELEASING.md's rollout order.
